models.name: Burgers continuum, Itasca9.0.184 equations; dry zero-spin ODE draft
models.description: Packet-only continuous-law specialization of Itasca9.0.184 continuum Burgers viscoelasticity. Positive finite parameters; dry total stress, infinitesimal fixed spatial frame and zero spin are explicit Atlas scope choices. Not the vendor centered finite-step algorithm, contact Burgers or Burgers-Mohr plasticity. Examples and numerical bounds are uncalibrated. No full-path, compiled, experimental or scientific admission.
